limitations: Conditional point-train equipment/engagement hypotheses; no measured actuator, adhesion, coupling, flexible train or protected service proof
Auxiliary energy is separate electrical demand; battery/charger/source and regenerative recovery are not modelled
Journey+dwelling is not station resource occupation or safe headway; no timetable, controller or movement authority

Force discontinuities are retained; jerk uses successive moving-step midpoint acceleration times, including shortened event steps. The terminal acceleration step is reported separately: Coulomb/static/hold transitions are not jerk-qualified
Aggregate thermal RC is a declared drive-loss hypothesis, not component temperatures or repeated-duty qualification
Traction power loss conditionally commands independent braking with the input latency/rise; actual control, brake supply independence and standstill retention are not authenticated

Position/speed/acceleration observations and policy brake/response bounds are declared hypotheses, not authenticated sensors or protection evidence; the controller does not receive actual plant mass/grade/adhesion
Initial holding brake, when selected, is an already-applied t<0 condition. Idle/standstill motor current and heat remain unmodelled

Docking uses an ideal standstill-event observation in addition to biased position/speed/acceleration signals; a real zero-speed detector is not authenticated. The 0.25 m/s docking request has a 0.5 m/s model guard, not a measured physical limit
